# ADR-1069: An empty value is not a wiki draft refinement

## Status

accepted

## Context

ADR-1068 refuses a `wiki_refine_draft` call whose `title`, `lead`, `sections` and `frontmatter` are all absent. It tests `is None`, which an empty value passes, and `update_draft` then writes it:

- `lead: ""` blanks the draft's lead. `draft_curator._lead_is_placeholder` reads the result as a placeholder and subtracts 0.25 from the draft's score, so a call that refined nothing leaves the draft worse than it found it.
- `frontmatter: {}` drops the `updated` stamp `core/draft_synthesizer.py` writes.
- `title: "   "` writes a blank title, which `evaluate_draft` scores at −0.3.
- `sections: []` is refused by the kind contract for any kind with a required section, and would replace the sections of a kind without one.

Each case also inserts a `refined_llm` memo recording a refinement that carried nothing. The review of PR #584 measured the first two against a real SQLite draft: both returned `updated: true` and wrote a memo (issue #585).

Nothing in Path B asks to blank a field. `wiki_write` replaces a page's content and `wiki_purge` removes a page; a draft is refined by submitting prose.

## Decision

A content field present in the call must carry a value. `_content_refusal` refuses the call and names every field whose value is empty, where empty means a blank or whitespace-only string, an empty list, or an empty mapping. The ADR-1068 refusal for a call with no content field at all is unchanged, and a refused call still writes neither the draft nor a memo.

A field the caller omits stays untouched, as before. Refusing by name rather than dropping the empty field silently keeps the caller's mistake visible.

## Consequences

Easier: a refinement can no longer degrade the draft it refines. Every `refined_llm` memo corresponds to content a model submitted, and no field is blanked by a call that meant to fill it.

`tests_py/handlers/test_wiki_refine_confidence.py::test_a_refine_carrying_an_empty_value_writes_nothing` drives five shapes on SQLite: blank lead, whitespace title, empty sections list, empty frontmatter, and a real lead paired with an empty title. Each asserts the four content columns, `synth_model` and the draft's memo count are unchanged and that the response names the offending field. All five fail on the ADR-1068 handler.

Harder: a caller that wants a field cleared has to do it outside Path B. No caller does; the tool has been registered only since ADR-1066.
